acceptance_criteria.text: With the default workspace root, catalogue-impl-signals excludes Cargo's target directory from the rustdoc input corpus.
With an explicit relative workspace root, catalogue-impl-signals excludes Cargo's target directory from the rustdoc input corpus.
If the selected workspace root cannot be normalized because it is missing or inaccessible, catalogue-impl-signals stops without processing an input corpus.
Path comparisons that determine target-directory exclusion use the normalized absolute workspace root, so equivalent relative and absolute root input cannot cause target files to be included.

constraints.text: The default and explicitly supplied workspace roots must each be normalized to absolute paths relative to the current directory at command startup.

goal.text: Make catalogue-impl-signals reliably exclude Cargo's target directory when invoked with its default or a relative workspace root.

in_scope.text: Normalize the default and explicit workspace-root inputs to absolute paths at command startup.
Use normalized absolute paths for target-directory exclusion and other comparable workspace-root path comparisons.
Reject an unavailable or inaccessible workspace root before catalogue processing begins.
Add regression coverage that proves a relative workspace-root input still excludes target/.

out_of_scope.text: Requiring users to supply --workspace-root $PWD is out of scope.
Adding relative-versus-absolute path handling separately at every comparison site is out of scope.
Supporting multiple workspace roots in one invocation is out of scope.

title: Catalogue Impl Signals Absolute Workspace Root
